# Anatomical reference API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Immutable, system-managed anatomical atlas release metadata.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `anatomical_reference` (detail, create, update), `anatomical_references` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `code` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/), [`coordinatetransform`](/api/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/), [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `code` | string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[read-only]** |
| `version` | string **[read-only]** |
| `species` | [`species`](/api/taxonomies/species/) id **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `organ` | one of `brain`, `spinal_cord`, `whole_body` **[read-only]** |
| `region_atlas_code` | string **[read-only]** |
| `coordinate_space_identifier` | string **[read-only]** |
| `axes_orientation` | JSON object **[read-only]** |
| `native_unit` | string **[read-only]** |
| `source` | string **[read-only]** |
| `homepage` | string **[read-only]** |
| `citation` | string **[read-only]** |
| `license_name` | string **[read-only]** |
| `license_url` | string **[read-only]** |
| `asset_manifest_url` | string **[read-only]** |
| `visualization_status` | one of `available`, `metadata_only`, `disabled` **[read-only]** |
| `is_active` | boolean **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('anatomicalreference', load_all=True)
records = resp['anatomical_references']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('anatomicalreference', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.anatomical_references;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('anatomicalreference', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['anatomical_reference']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('anatomicalreference', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.anatomical_reference;
```

## Writing

This resource is maintained by BrainSTEM administrators or system processes and is read-only through the REST API.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Anatomical reference data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/).
